title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 5

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the controlled-release session take place?
tasks.audioText: The documentation manager will explain controlled release of maintenance documents on Friday at eleven. Students should meet in the technical library and bring the sample release checklist. The session will review document applicability, approval status, revision identification and distribution. The manager will emphasise that a draft should not be confused with an approved release.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which checklist should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The documentation manager will explain controlled release of maintenance documents on Friday at eleven. Students should meet in the technical library and bring the sample release checklist. The session will review document applicability, approval status, revision identification and distribution. The manager will emphasise that a draft should not be confused with an approved release.
options: The revision register and approval record
The task card and applicability list
The distribution log and maintenance instruction

tasks.prompt: Before a maintenance document is released, its applicability and revision should be checked and the required approval recorded. The distribution process should make the current version available to the intended users and prevent obsolete copies from being used. A draft may contain useful information, but it should remain clearly identified as a draft until the approval process is complete. Reading 1. What should be checked before a maintenance document is released?
options: Staff availability, meeting time and distribution list
Equipment location, storage label and serial number
Supplier price, delivery date and payment terms

tasks.prompt: How should a draft be identified?
options: Approved for immediate use before review
Obsolete and withdrawn from the document register
Clearly identified as a draft until approval is complete

tasks.prompt: The document ___ as a draft until approval is complete.
Choose TWO controls needed before releasing a maintenance document.
options: Distribute an unapproved draft as current

tasks.prompt: The formal permission for a document to be issued for use is its ___.
A colleague wants to use a draft as an approved instruction. What should you say?
options: This copy is still a draft; we need to confirm the approved release before using it as current documentation.
The approval status is not important.
I will change the status label myself.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of maintenance documentation release in a logical order.
options: Distribute the approved current version and control obsolete copies
correctOrder: Distribute the approved current version and control obsolete copies

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words explaining the controls required before a maintenance document is released. Include applicability, revision, approval and distribution.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total. Score each criterion 0–2: (1) Applicability — 2: explains checking model/configuration and intended use; 1: partial; 0: absent. (2) Revision and approval — 2: explains verification of current revision, review and approval status; 1: partial; 0: absent. (3) Distribution control — 2: explains controlled release, access to the current version and prevention of obsolete copies; 1: partial; 0: absent. (4) English — 2: clear sequence and accurate document-control vocabulary; 1: errors but meaning clear; 0: meaning frequently unclear.
